changelog:
RS Optimization v1.15.0 — Complete Utility Categories
• New categories: Resources, Fixes, General, Debloating, Networking, Advanced, Services, Game Profiles, App Optimizer, BIOS, Windows Optimization, Wallpapers & Themes.
• Full channel structure with searchable cards, rounded RS styling and outline navigation icons.
• Read-only inventories for desktop/Store apps, Windows services, adapters/DNS, motherboard/BIOS and memory.
• General and Advanced pages expose existing reversible RS tweaks, exact changes and applied state.
• Networking includes jitter probes and adapter inventory; Game Profiles connects to existing FiveM and GPU tools.
• App Optimizer covers Edge, Chrome, Brave, Opera, Opera GX, Firefox, Discord and Spotify.
• Existing v1.14.0 expert tools and Remember me remain included.
Validation: 45 checks passed. Paragon proprietary code/assets/presets are not included.
Detailed changelog: https://github.com/NutzuSefu/rs-config/releases/tag/v1.15.0
